hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Who painted the Mona Lisa? A. Rembrandt. B. Michelangelo. C. Leonardo da Vinci. D. Raphael.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, Leonardo da Vinci.

questions.question: Who painted The Starry Night?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Who painted The Starry Night? A. Claude Monet. B. Vincent van Gogh. C. Paul Cezanne. D. Edvard Munch.
questions.answer_speech: B is correct, Vincent van Gogh.

questions.question: In which museum is the Mona Lisa displayed?
questions.question_speech: Question three. In which museum is the Mona Lisa displayed? A. The Prado. B. The Uffizi. C. The British Museum. D. The Louvre.

questions.question: Which artist co-founded Cubism and painted Guernica?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which artist co-founded Cubism and painted Guernica? A. Pablo Picasso. B. Henri Matisse. C. Andy Warhol. D. Salvador Dali.

questions.question: What color do you get by mixing red and blue paint?
questions.question_speech: Question five. What color do you get by mixing red and blue paint? A. Orange. B. Purple. C. Green. D. Brown.

questions.question: Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel? A. Leonardo da Vinci. B. Donatello. C. Raphael. D. Michelangelo.

questions.question: Which artist painted The Scream?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. Which artist painted The Scream? A. Francisco Goya. B. Paul Gauguin. C. Edvard Munch. D. Gustav Klimt.

questions.question: Which painter is famous for his Water Lilies series?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Which painter is famous for his Water Lilies series? A. Claude Monet. B. Vincent van Gogh. C. Georges Seurat. D. Edgar Degas.

questions.question: Who painted Girl with a Pearl Earring?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. Who painted Girl with a Pearl Earring? A. Rembrandt. B. Jan van Eyck. C. Peter Paul Rubens. D. Johannes Vermeer.

questions.question: Which Spanish artist painted The Persistence of Memory with its melting clocks?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. Which Spanish artist painted The Persistence of Memory with its melting clocks? A. Joan Miro. B. Salvador Dali. C. Diego Velazquez. D. Francisco Goya.

questions.question: Who painted The Birth of Venus?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Who painted The Birth of Venus? A. Caravaggio. B. Titian. C. Sandro Botticelli. D. Giotto.

questions.question: Which art movement is Claude Monet associated with?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which art movement is Claude Monet associated with? A. Cubism. B. Impressionism. C. Surrealism. D. Baroque.

questions.question: Frida Kahlo, famous for her self-portraits, was from which country?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Frida Kahlo, famous for her self-portraits, was from which country? A. Argentina. B. Cuba. C. Mexico. D. Spain.

questions.question: What color do you get by mixing blue and yellow paint?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. What color do you get by mixing blue and yellow paint? A. Pink. B. Purple. C. Orange. D. Green.

questions.question: Which artist painted The Kiss, known for its gold leaf?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. Which artist painted The Kiss, known for its gold leaf? A. Gustav Klimt. B. Egon Schiele. C. Auguste Rodin. D. Henri Matisse.
